d:
This week, former New York Fed President Bill Dudley and Kathryn Judge of Columbia Law School discuss what the Treasury and Fed can do to tackle the nation’s debt crisis. Plus, what Grand Theft Auto 6’s release means for a video game industry that routinely faces layoffs, delays and slowing consumer spending. Later, surging healthcare costs affect businesses and their employees as Americans choose their insurance policies for the year ahead. And, how is AI changing the cybersecurity stakes for small businesses?
